name: catalog-grpc
description: Example gRPC service: a product catalog that the router calls as a subgraph through Cosmo Connect (D35). The GraphQL contract is schema.graphql; service.proto and mapping.json are what `wgc grpc-service generate` wrote from it, and the service implements the proto. The router checks the token (D19) and passes it on as gRPC metadata; this example does not check it again. Its source is apis/catalog-grpc; build the image with: docker build -t ghcr.io/rudney5000/plugbricks/catalog-grpc:0.1.0 apis/catalog-grpc
